grammar.purpose: Interpret laughter through the surrounding turn
grammar.explanation: 哈哈 writes a laugh, not an automatic insult or agreement. It can follow amusement, self-directed humour or relaxed banter. Who or what the joke targets depends on context. If the listener is uncomfortable, clarify rather than insisting that a laugh proves friendliness. Spoken laughter need not literally pronounce two citation syllables; these written examples are read as language practice.

examples.zh: 哈哈，我又把日期看错了。
examples.py: hā hā , wǒ yòu bǎ rì qī kàn cuò le .
examples.en: Ha ha, I misread the date again.

examples.zh: 你笑什么？我在笑自己的玩笑。
examples.py: nǐ xiào shén me ? wǒ zài xiào zì jǐ de wán xiào .
examples.en: What are you laughing at? My own joke.

examples.zh: 哈哈只是笑声，不能证明大家同意。
examples.py: hā hā zhǐ shì xiào shēng , bù néng zhèng míng dà jiā tóng yì .
examples.en: “Ha ha” is only laughter; it does not prove everyone agrees.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她写哈哈，所以一定在笑我。
commonMistakes.right: 她写哈哈，我先问她在笑什么。
commonMistakes.why: Laughter alone does not identify its target.

grammar.pattern: 用疑问语调提问，不必都有吗
grammar.purpose: Recognize a confirmation question in context
grammar.explanation: An utterance with statement word order can be a confirmation question through intonation and context: 你今天也来参加这个活动？ No 吗 is required. Question intonation does not erase Mandarin lexical tones; it is not a rule to replace every final syllable’s tone with a rise. Compare a question seeking confirmation with a statement giving confirmed information. These synthesized examples are practice, not a certified acoustic minimal-pair test.

examples.zh: 你今天也来参加这个活动？我确认一下。
examples.py: nǐ jīn tiān yě lái cān jiā zhè gè huó dòng ? wǒ què rèn yī xià .
examples.en: Are you also joining this event today? Let me confirm.

examples.zh: 他今天也来，我已经问过了。
examples.py: tā jīn tiān yě lái , wǒ yǐ jīng wèn guò le .
examples.en: He is joining today too; I have already asked.

examples.zh: 你说的时间是周五晚上？我怕记错了。
examples.py: nǐ shuō de shí jiān shì zhōu wǔ wǎn shang ? wǒ pà jì cuò le .
examples.en: The time you said was Friday evening? I am worried I remembered incorrectly.

commonMistakes.wrong: 没有吗，所以不能是问题。
commonMistakes.right: 没有吗，也可以用疑问语调确认。
commonMistakes.why: Question particles are not the only way to ask a question.

dialogue.blurb: An original scene written for this course.

lines.zh: 哈哈，你怎么把周六看成周日了？
lines.py: hā hā , nǐ zěn me bǎ zhōu liù kàn chéng zhōu rì le ?
lines.en: Ha! How did you read Saturday as Sunday?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我看错了。你干吗一直笑？
lines.py: wǒ kàn cuò le . nǐ gàn má yì zhí xiào ?
lines.en: I misread it. Why are you still laughing?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不是笑你，我上次星期一才去，门都关了。
lines.py: bù shì xiào nǐ , wǒ shàng cì xīng qī yī cái qù , mén dōu guān le .
lines.en: I'm not laughing at you. Last time I went on Monday; the place was closed.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那你比我还晚一天。
lines.py: nà nǐ bǐ wǒ hái wǎn yī tiān .
lines.en: Then you were a day later than me.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 所以我们这次一起去，谁也别一个人看通知。
lines.py: suǒ yǐ wǒ men zhè cì yì qǐ qù , shéi yě bié yī gè rén kàn tōng zhī .
lines.en: So let's go together this time and check the notice together.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，你念时间，我看地址。
lines.py: hǎo , nǐ niàn shí jiān , wǒ kàn dì zhǐ .
lines.en: You read the time aloud; I'll look at the address.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 周六，下午两点。
lines.py: zhōu liù , xià wǔ liǎng diǎn .
lines.en: Saturday, two in the afternoon.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你突然说这么大声干吗？我听见了。
lines.py: nǐ tū rán shuō zhè me dà shēng gàn má ? wǒ tīng jiàn le .
lines.en: Why did you suddenly get so loud? I heard you.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我怕你又听成周日。
lines.py: wǒ pà nǐ yòu tīng chéng zhōu rì .
lines.en: I was worried you'd hear Sunday again.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好好说就行，我还没紧张到连两点都听不见。
lines.py: hǎo hǎo shuō jiù xíng , wǒ hái méi jǐn zhāng dào lián liǎng diǎn dōu tīng bú jiàn .
lines.en: Just speak normally. I'm not so nervous that I can't hear two o'clock.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行，周六一点半在车站见？
lines.py: xíng , zhōu liù yī diǎn bàn zài chē zhàn jiàn ?
lines.en: All right. Shall we meet at the station at one thirty on Saturday?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。要是我星期一才来，你就别等了。
lines.py: hǎo . yào shì wǒ xīng qī yī cái lái , nǐ jiù bié děng le .
lines.en: Yes. If I turn up on Monday, don't wait for me.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Lively, not careless
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 我把活动时间看成周日下午两点，准备约陈宇一起去。他看了通知，问我为什么要晚一天。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ huó dòng shí jiān kàn chéng zhōu rì xià wǔ liǎng diǎn , zhǔn bèi yuē chén yǔ yì qǐ qù . tā kàn le tōng zhī , wèn wǒ wèi shén me yào wǎn yī tiān .
lines.en: I read the event time as two on Sunday afternoon and was about to invite Chen Yu. He looked at the notice and asked why I wanted to go a day late.

lines.zh: 我有点不好意思。他却笑起来，说自己上次星期一才到，门口连一个人都没有。我也笑了，原来不是只有我会看错。
lines.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn bù hǎo yì sī . tā què xiào qǐ lái , shuō zì jǐ shàng cì xīng qī yī cái dào , mén kǒu lián yī gè rén dōu méi yǒu . wǒ yě xiào le , yuán lái bù shì zhǐ yǒu wǒ huì kàn cuò .
lines.en: I felt embarrassed. He laughed and said he had gone on Monday last time, when no one was at the door. I laughed too: I was not the only one who misread it.

lines.zh: 这次我们把通知再看一遍。他念时间，我读地址，读完还把两个信息写在一起。活动是周六下午两点，我们约一点半在车站见。
lines.py: zhè cì wǒ men bǎ tōng zhī zài kàn yī biàn . tā niàn shí jiān , wǒ dú dì zhǐ , dú wán hái bǎ liǎng gè xìn xī xiě zài yì qǐ . huó dòng shì zhōu liù xià wǔ liǎng diǎn , wǒ men yuē yī diǎn bàn zài chē zhàn jiàn .
lines.en: This time we checked the notice again. He read the time and I read the address; we wrote both down together. The event was at two on Saturday, so we arranged to meet at the station at one thirty.

lines.zh: 周六我一点二十分就到了。陈宇来时问我是不是紧张，我说不是，刚才那班车来得早，我就上了。
lines.py: zhōu liù wǒ yī diǎn èr shí fēn jiù dào le . chén yǔ lái shí wèn wǒ shì bú shì jǐn zhāng , wǒ shuō bù shì , gāng cái nà bān chē lái de zǎo , wǒ jiù shàng le .
lines.en: I reached the station at one twenty on Saturday. When Chen Yu asked if I was nervous, I explained that an early bus had come along and I had taken it.

lines.zh: 我们到门口时，里面已经有音乐声。今天真有人，陈宇说完自己先笑了。我让他进去再笑，后面还有人在等。
lines.py: wǒ men dào mén kǒu shí , lǐ miàn yǐ jīng yǒu yīn yuè shēng . jīn tiān zhēn yǒu rén , chén yǔ shuō wán zì jǐ xiān xiào le . wǒ ràng tā jìn qù zài xiào , hòu miàn hái yǒu rén zài děng .
lines.en: At the entrance we could already hear music. Chen Yu said there really were people there today and laughed. I told him to go in before laughing: others were waiting behind us.

lines.zh: 表演结束后，我们在路边吃东西。陈宇问下周还来不来，我说先看看日期，今天总算没白跑。
lines.py: biǎo yǎn jié shù hòu , wǒ men zài lù biān chī dōng xi . chén yǔ wèn xià zhōu hái lái bù lái , wǒ shuō xiān kàn kàn rì qī , jīn tiān zǒng suàn méi bái pǎo .
lines.en: After the performance we ate by the road. Chen Yu asked about coming next week. I suggested checking the date first. At least we had not made a wasted trip today.

choices: They check the notice and reach the right event
They go a day late again
questions.answer: They check the notice and reach the right event

choices: The performance began at one twenty

choices: Chen Yu remembers his earlier trip to a closed venue

lines.zh: 她在消息里写了哈哈。
lines.py: tā zài xiāo xī lǐ xiě le hā hā .
lines.en: She wrote “haha” in her message.

lines.zh: 哈哈，原来你也忘了。
lines.py: hā hā , yuán lái nǐ yě wàng le .
lines.en: Ha! So you forgot too.

lines.zh: 你干吗穿这么多？
lines.py: nǐ gàn má chuān zhè me duō ?
lines.en: Why are you wearing so many layers?

lines.zh: 你站在门口干吗？
lines.py: nǐ zhàn zài mén kǒu gàn má ?
lines.en: What are you doing at the door?

lines.zh: 他们换了一个话题。
lines.py: tā men huàn le yī gè huà tí .
lines.en: They changed the subject.

lines.zh: 这个话题我们昨天谈过。
lines.py: zhè gè huà tí wǒ men zuó tiān tán guò .
lines.en: We discussed this subject yesterday.

lines.zh: 她给奶奶念了一封信。
lines.py: tā gěi nǎi nai niàn le yī fēng xìn .
lines.en: She read a letter aloud to her grandmother.

lines.zh: 你念慢一点，我想记下来。
lines.py: nǐ niàn màn yī diǎn , wǒ xiǎng jì xià lái .
lines.en: Read more slowly; I'd like to write it down.

lines.zh: 突然下雨了。
lines.py: tū rán xià yǔ le .
lines.en: It suddenly started raining.

lines.zh: 门突然开了，我吓了一跳。
lines.py: mén tū rán kāi le , wǒ xià le yī tiào .
lines.en: The door suddenly opened and startled me.

lines.zh: 他快速收好东西就出门了。
lines.py: tā kuài sù shōu hǎo dōng xi jiù chū mén le .
lines.en: He quickly packed his things and left.

lines.zh: 这个方法可以快速找到文件。
lines.py: zhè gè fāng fǎ kě yǐ kuài sù zhǎo dào wén jiàn .
lines.en: This method finds files quickly.

lines.zh: 车的速度慢下来了。
lines.py: chē de sù dù màn xià lái le .
lines.en: The car slowed down.

lines.zh: 他跑步的速度比我快。
lines.py: tā pǎo bù de sù dù bǐ wǒ kuài .
lines.en: He runs faster than I do.

lines.zh: 夜里，这条街很静。
lines.py: yè lǐ , zhè tiáo jiē hěn jìng .
lines.en: This street is quiet at night.

lines.zh: 屋里很静，只听得见钟的声音。
lines.py: wū lǐ hěn jìng , zhǐ tīng de jiàn zhōng de shēng yīn .
lines.en: The room is quiet; only the clock can be heard.

lines.zh: 她第一次上台，有点紧张。
lines.py: tā dì yī cì shàng tái , yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng .
lines.en: She is nervous about going on stage for the first time.

lines.zh: 别紧张，我陪你进去。
lines.py: bié jǐn zhāng , wǒ péi nǐ jìn qù .
lines.en: Don't be nervous; I'll go in with you.

lines.zh: 听到这句话，他乐了。
lines.py: tīng dào zhè jù huà , tā lè le .
lines.en: He laughed at those words.

lines.zh: 他们一边看照片一边乐。
lines.py: tā men yī biān kàn zhào piān yī biān lè .
lines.en: They laughed while looking at the photos.

lines.zh: 她对明年的生活很乐观。
lines.py: tā duì míng nián de shēng huó hěn lè guān .
lines.en: She is optimistic about life next year.

lines.zh: 他总能找到办法，很乐观。
lines.py: tā zǒng néng zhǎo dào bàn fǎ , hěn lè guān .
lines.en: He always finds a way and is optimistic.

lines.zh: 大家一起度过了一个欢乐的晚上。
lines.py: dà jiā yì qǐ dù guò le yī gè huān lè de wǎn shang .
lines.en: Everyone enjoyed a happy evening together.

lines.zh: 屋里充满了欢乐的笑声。
lines.py: wū lǐ chōng mǎn le huān lè de xiào shēng .
lines.en: The room was full of happy laughter.

lines.zh: 他把这个人物演活了。
lines.py: tā bǎ zhè gè rén wù yǎn huó le .
lines.en: He brought this character to life.

lines.zh: 她把故事讲得很活。
lines.py: tā bǎ gù shì jiǎng de hěn huó .
lines.en: She tells the story vividly.

lines.zh: 老师讲的故事很生动。
lines.py: lǎo shī jiǎng de gù shì hěn shēng dòng .
lines.en: The teacher's story is vivid.

lines.zh: 这张照片生动地表现了当时的生活。
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān shēng dòng de biǎo xiàn le dāng shí de shēng huó .
lines.en: This photo vividly captures life at that time.

lines.zh: 她的歌声很动人。
lines.py: tā de gē shēng hěn dòng rén .
lines.en: Her singing is moving.

lines.zh: 这是一个很动人的故事。
lines.py: zhè shì yī gè hěn dòng rén de gù shì .
lines.en: This is a very moving story.

lines.zh: 他今天的表现比上次好。
lines.py: tā jīn tiān de biǎo xiàn bǐ shàng cì hǎo .
lines.en: He did better today than last time.

lines.zh: 她在比赛中表现得很好。
lines.py: tā zài bǐ sài zhōng biǎo xiàn de hěn hǎo .
lines.en: She performed well in the competition.

lines.zh: 我们晚上去看表演。
lines.py: wǒ men wǎn shang qù kàn biǎo yǎn .
lines.en: We're going to see a performance tonight.

lines.zh: 孩子们准备了一个小表演。
lines.py: hái zi men zhǔn bèi le yī gè xiǎo biǎo yǎn .
lines.en: The children prepared a short performance.

lines.zh: 他的进步很明显。
lines.py: tā de jìn bù hěn míng xiǎn .
lines.en: His progress is clear.

lines.zh: 两张图的区别很明显。
lines.py: liǎng zhāng tú de qū bié hěn míng xiǎn .
lines.en: The difference between the two pictures is obvious.

lines.zh: 睡了一觉，我精神多了。
lines.py: shuì le yī jué , wǒ jīng shen duō le .
lines.en: After some sleep, I feel much more energetic.

lines.zh: 她今天看着很精神。
lines.py: tā jīn tiān kàn zhe hěn jīng shen .
lines.en: She looks full of energy today.

lines.zh: 今天状态不错，我想再跑一圈。
lines.py: jīn tiān zhuàng tài bù cuò , wǒ xiǎng zài pǎo yī quān .
lines.en: I'm feeling good today; I'd like another lap.

lines.zh: 他工作时的状态比昨天好。
lines.py: tā gōng zuò shí de zhuàng tài bǐ zuó tiān hǎo .
lines.en: He is doing better at work than yesterday.

lines.zh: 孩子们自觉把玩具收好了。
lines.py: hái zi men zì jué bǎ wán jù shōu hǎo le .
lines.en: The children put their toys away without being asked.

lines.zh: 大家都很自觉，没有人插队。
lines.py: dà jiā dōu hěn zì jué , méi yǒu rén chā duì .
lines.en: Everyone behaved considerately; no one cut the queue.

lines.zh: 回去好好休息吧。
lines.py: huí qù hǎo hǎo xiū xī ba .
lines.en: Go home and get a good rest.

lines.zh: 我想好好学做饭。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng hǎo hǎo xué zuò fàn .
lines.en: I'd like to learn to cook properly.

audio.zh: 行，周六一点半在车站见？
audio.py: xíng , zhōu liù yī diǎn bàn zài chē zhàn jiàn ?
audio.en: All right. Shall we meet at the station at one thirty on Saturday?

tasks.statement: They arrange to meet at the station on Saturday at one thirty.
tasks.why: The line explicitly states this detail.

audio.zh: 表演结束后，我们在路边吃东西。陈宇问下周还来不来，我说先看看日期，今天总算没白跑。
audio.py: biǎo yǎn jié shù hòu , wǒ men zài lù biān chī dōng xi . chén yǔ wèn xià zhōu hái lái bù lái , wǒ shuō xiān kàn kàn rì qī , jīn tiān zǒng suàn méi bái pǎo .
audio.en: After the performance we ate by the road. Chen Yu asked about coming next week. I suggested checking the date first. At least we had not made a wasted trip today.

tasks.statement: They left without seeing the performance.
tasks.why: The passage gives a different outcome.

AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三31, 三78. Native check: 精神 adjective jīngshen versus noun jīngshén, 活 for lively delivery, 乐 verb register, 干吗 casual tone, 哈哈 target and written-versus-spontaneous laughter, original verse rhythm, and question intonation preserving lexical tones. Synthesized intonation has not been certified by a native listener. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三25 / 三71 / 三28 / 三38: 因为没核对，我发了旧通知。, 由于通知有错，所以先停止传播旧通知。, 除了看节目，我还听广播。, 除了周五，其他几天都可以。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Earlier HSK 3 naturalness correction: delivery and a wet bag; two friends catching up on a show; noodles with chilli served separately; friends admitting date mistakes. Corrected quilt/chair continuity: trousers move to the other chair, the old quilt joins them, and both are removed before the seat is free. Formal vocabulary uses independent contexts rather than speech that sounds like a report. Replaced abstract caution and assessment-policy dialogue. All target words get two independently authored contexts, and old word/task/unit IDs remain intact. Native flags: colloquial passive 叫, 具有 with formal collocations, 广大 in public notices, the playful eating invitation, 活 as vivid portrayal and 乐 lè as laughter. All distractors and true/false keys were checked against the rewritten facts. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
